targets.authors: Baillon, Aurélien, Zhenxing Huang, Asli Selim, and Peter P. Wakker.
targets.title: Measuring ambiguity attitudes for all (natural) events.
targets.evidence_quote: We selected the claim that TP [time pressure] will reduce cognitive understanding and, hence, increase the insensitivity index [insensitivity toward likelihood changes]. This reflects the following statement from the paper’s abstract: “People do not become more ambiguity averse under time pressure but become more insensitive (perceive more ambiguity).”
targets.outcome_quote: Thus, this replication of the claim was successful according to the SCORE criteria.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The final report explicitly declares the focal test successful (t = 2.81, p = 0.005). Follow the author verdict despite inconsistent index labels in the report.
